start.title: [TODO:es] The Crowd Follows
start.text:
[TODO:es] Thousands have climbed the hill.
They hunger for his every word.

send_away.title: [TODO:es] He Will Not Turn Them Away
send_away.text:
[TODO:es] His eyes hold the whole crowd.
None will leave empty.

rest_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Mercy First
rest_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Their hunger is his concern.
Stand ready beside him.

compassion.title: [TODO:es] Evening Falls
compassion.text:
[TODO:es] "They have nothing to eat."
The disciples murmur in fear.

count_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Not by Silver
count_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Two hundred coins would not be enough.
Look with new eyes.

boy.title: [TODO:es] A Small Offering
boy.text:
[TODO:es] A boy lifts a humble basket.
Five loaves. Two small fish.

choices.feedback: [TODO:es] Faith places it in his hands.

dismiss_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Little Is Much
dismiss_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] In his hands, little is plenty.
Receive the boy's gift.

mock_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Honor the Gift
mock_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] His brave little heart deserves more.
Carry his basket gently.

bless.title: [TODO:es] He Lifts His Eyes
bless.text:
[TODO:es] He raises the bread to heaven.
A hush falls on the hillside.

unbelief_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Stay and See
unbelief_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] The miracle begins in his hands.
Do not miss it.

distribute.title: [TODO:es] Pass It On
distribute.text:
[TODO:es] He breaks. He gives. He breaks again.
The baskets do not empty.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Serve the crowd row by row

hide_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Trust the Giver
hide_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] There is plenty for every mouth.
Keep no portion back.

choices.text: [TODO:es] Serve the crowd row by row

feast.title: [TODO:es] All Are Filled
feast.text:
[TODO:es] Families eat together on green grass.
No one rises hungry.

waste_consequence.title: [TODO:es] Gather It All
waste_consequence.text:
[TODO:es] Every fragment is mercy made bread.
Let nothing be lost.

baskets.title: [TODO:es] Twelve Baskets Full
baskets.text:
[TODO:es] From a boy's gift, abundance overflows.
With little, he gives much.
